item.tib: gsas mkhar zhi khro rab 'byams rtsa gsum kun 'dus che mchog dreg pa spyi 'dul gyi bsgrub gzhung
item.coloph: bdag 'dra snyig ma'i sngags 'chang dbal 'bar stag slag can la/ gter bdag ye shes dbal mo'i (mos) lung bstan nas/ chu byi lo hor zla lnga pa'i tshes nyer gsum gyi srod 'khor la/ lho phyogs rgyal mo tsha ba rong ngo mtshar bkod pa'i zhing khams/ gnas mchog bkra shis spungs pa'i ri bo nas gter las spyan drangs te/ slar shing pho stag gi lo/ hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes la/ mdangs ldan g.yung drung gling du shog ser bod yig tu bsgyur ba dge'o//
